name: PL Universe
summary:
PL Universe develops embodied robots for industrial work, combining complete machines with AI and deployment services. Founded in Suzhou in January 2025, the company presents its ProWhite robot as a platform for adaptable physical automation. Its technology architecture connects sensing, decision-making and action to support tasks in operating environments.

The company's target markets include electronics and automotive manufacturing. It emphasizes adapting robots to customer processes, collecting operational data and improving capabilities through continued use. This makes its offering a combination of robot hardware, software and application engineering, with development focused on practical production tasks rather than a single fixed robot motion.
